core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aabid is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Worshipper, one who serves God”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aabid corresponds to the Arabic form عابد (Arabic root ع ب د (ʿ-b-d); عَابِد (ʿĀbid)). Its core sense is servant, young man; servant (of god). Aabid is Arabic عَابِد (ʿĀbid) 'worshipper, one who serves God', the active participle of the root ع ب د (ʿ-b-d). The source gloss 'Servant of God' is broadly consistent; the precise lexical sense is 'worshipper'.

persian.name: عابد
persian.long_meaning: Aabid (عابد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن غلام، خدمتگزار است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आबिद
